archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy + Archetype 4: Swiss Clarity
design_philosophy: A digital tool that feels like a premium French kitchen: warm, organic, but ruthlessly organized. Minimalist data presentation combined with tactile, earthy surfaces.

scale_rules.labels: text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] font-bold text-stone-500

layout_and_spacing.card: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm
layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-stone-200 flex justify-around items-center z-50

components.welcome_banner: Relative container, h-36 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden mb-6. Image background with bg-black/40 gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Use Cormorant Garamond for the restaurant name.
components.kpi_card: Card with subtle border, no heavy shadows. Value text large and tracking-tighter. Use pill badges for positive/negative trends (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800).
components.period_selector: Pill-shaped segmented control. bg-stone-100 p-1 rounded-full flex. Active item has bg-white, shadow-sm, rounded-full.
components.product_list: Flat rows with 1px bottom border. Image thumbnail + title + stock badge. Clean optical alignment.
components.bottom_nav_item: Flex col, items-center, gap-1. Active state: text-primary color (#2C4A3B), icon filled. Inactive: text-stone-400.

micro_interactions.tabs: relative, active indicator smooth background transition

welcome_banner_images.description: Luxurious dining room in a French restaurant, used for the dashboard welcome header background.
Vibrant cutting board scene with fresh ingredients, used as a header for the Production tab.

technical_rules: Mobile-first: Ensure strict mobile responsiveness. No horizontal scroll/overflow.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Replace existing custom App.css variables with Tailwind configuration in tailwind.config.js.
Ensure generous padding-bottom on the main content wrapper so the fixed bottom nav doesn't hide content.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom color palette (primary: #2C4A3B, base: #FAFAF8, etc.) and custom font families (Manrope, Work Sans, Cormorant Garamond).
2. Completely refactor the Dashboard/Home to use the bento_grid pattern. Create a rich Welcome Banner using the provided image URL.
3. Build a Bottom Navigation bar pinned to the bottom using backdrop-blur glassmorphism. It should cover Home, Stock, Production, and Orders.
4. For Stock and Production pages, use clean list rows (product cards) with clear visual hierarchy for critical stock levels (use the accent_terracotta color for alerts).
5. Implement a horizontal scrollable tab list for Production categories without visible scrollbars.
6. Remove old legacy CSS from App.css and rely entirely on Tailwind CSS.
